placement.outside_full_m2r: theta state may be persisted/observed, but must not independently activate full future simulation

historical_predictive_links: theta influence on BrainWave phrase score
historical_lineage.interpretation: The historical Beacon already coupled Theta to prediction/future/state; ADV_Elite formalizes that lineage inside M2R.

dual_trace.theta_on: normal M2R candidate/forecast path with bounded theta contribution
dual_trace.theta_off: internal ablation/control path with theta contribution neutralized
dual_trace.purpose: Measure incremental value of Theta on the same frozen input/horizon and later real outcome.

adaptive_weight.may_increase: only from repeated future-holdout gain vs theta-off control
adaptive_weight.may_decrease_to_zero: if Theta adds no reproducible predictive/calibration value

truth_guards: Theta is a mathematical/model feature, not physical tachyon evidence.
Theta resonance is not anomaly evidence by itself.
Theta cannot activate M2R; 1488 remains the only full-M2R gate.
A visually interesting q-series pattern is not predictive gain.
Promotion of theta weight is based on future holdout/replay comparison, not training loss alone.
